concern: Distress and fear from intrusive scary thoughts that something bad will happen, feeling unable to get them out of their head.
first_advice: There are 3 steps to doing this: Get distance from your thoughts by adding "I am noticing I'm having the thought that..."
acknowledged_before_advice: Opens by normalizing the experience: "having these thoughts is completely normal... so you are not alone." It then uses the tornado image to reflect how consuming and frightening the thoughts feel.
label: acknowledges_first
